events._doc: Abstract event -> concrete per-harness event name.

harness-materialize.note: Re-renders the store-to-harness projection when a copilot session starts; never blocks. antigravity has no session-start event; opencode, pi and Claude re-render through their own session-start paths.

block-git-stash.note: Exit 2 blocks; reads tool_input, tool_args or a generic payload. opencode also runs it, through the generated agent-context-guards.js plugin. To validate a harness, ask the agent to run `git stash` and confirm the refusal.

guard-git-write.note: Blocks git commit, push and merge outside a worktree. opencode also runs it, through the generated plugin.

require-worktree-edit.note: Blocks project-source edits in a main checkout; reads file_path, path or notebook_path. opencode also runs it, through the generated plugin.

plain-language-check.note: Blocks hard-list jargon, British spelling and the em dash in new prose. Signals with stderr plus exit 2 and also prints the Claude JSON deny on stdout. Runs on shell and edit tools. Word lists come from global/scripts/plain-language-words.py. To validate a harness, confirm a write containing an em dash is refused.

block-write-outside-home.note: Refuses a write outside $HOME unless user approved the directory with write-outside-home-consent.py. Runs on shell and edit tools: one script reads a command or a path. Needs global/scripts/shell-command-scan.py for shell payloads and fails open without it. To validate a harness, confirm `echo x > /tmp/probe` and a Write to /tmp/probe are refused.

block-deploy.note: Not portable: it derives deploy authorization from the Claude session transcript. Wired for Claude by home-settings-sync.py; pi runs it through the dispatcher entries below.

dispatch-SessionStart.note: pi runs the Claude hook dispatcher once per event, through the generated extension agent-context-hooks.ts. The dispatcher is a store script and reads its guard list from the generated hook-dispatch.json in the store root.

dispatch-PreToolUse.note: See dispatch-SessionStart. Also runs for a command the user types with the bang prefix (user_bash).

dispatch-Stop.note: See dispatch-SessionStart. A refusal feeds its reason back as a new turn; the third refusal in a row ends the turn.

_managed-elsewhere.note: Claude's hooks, these guards included, are wired by the MANAGED table in home-settings-sync.py, which is the one list of them.
